target: Sopra Banking Software (SBS) - most activities, carved out of Sopra Steria

deal_value.notes: Enterprise value EUR 330M, converted at ~1.08 EUR/USD (Feb 2024) = ~US$357M (approximate). Financed via ~EUR 131M capital increase + ~EUR 200M new credit facilities. Exclusive discussions announced Feb 21, 2024; binding agreements signed May 31/Jun 2, 2024; completed Sep 2, 2024. Perimeter = ~80% of SBS activities.

calculable.calculation: EUR 330M EV / ~EUR 340M FY2023 revenue of the acquired activities = ~0.97x (in USD: ~$357M / ~$368M = ~0.97x)
inputs: EV EUR 330M - FinTech Futures: https://www.fintechfutures.com/m-a/axway-completes-330m-acquisition-of-sopra-banking-software (citing Axway announcements)

Acquired activities revenue ~EUR 340M in FY2023 (~80% of SBS) - The Paypers: https://thepaypers.com/online-mobile-banking/axway-to-acquire-most-sopra-banking-software-activities--1266926 and PAC/SITSI: https://sitsi.pacanalyst.com/sopra-steria-clarifies-its-strategic-direction-by-selling-a-majority-stake-in-sopra-banking-software-sbs/
calculable.caveats: FinTech Futures separately cites EUR 359M standalone revenue for the acquired activities (apparently a 2024 figure at completion), vs ~EUR 340M FY2023 at announcement - implied multiple is ~0.9-1.0x depending on period. No EBITDA disclosed for the perimeter, so no EV/EBITDA. Axway.com and BusinessWire primary releases returned 403 via the network proxy, so exact press-release wording was not independently re-verified; figures are consistent across multiple trade outlets citing those releases.

sources.title: FinTech Futures - Axway completes EUR 330m acquisition of Sopra Banking Software
The Paypers - Axway to acquire most Sopra Banking Software activities
PAC SITSI - Sopra Steria sells majority stake in Sopra Banking Software (SBS)

notes: Parties as hinted: Axway (Euronext-listed, itself Sopra-affiliated) acquiring most of Sopra Banking Software from Sopra Steria - both French listed, terms published in EUR. No explicit multiple stated in coverage found, but EV and perimeter revenue were both published, so ~1x revenue is directly computable. Announced date used is the Feb 2024 exclusive-discussions announcement (terms already public then).
